review: candidate — promote to its strongest durable form: script fix > lint rule > guide prose. Bar: seen in ≥2 independent runs, verified against ground truth, or reviewer judgment. Contradicted → mark deprecated here (with evidence), don't delete.

learnings.statement: On Velt V2 sidebar primitives, defaultCondition={false} is the universal escape hatch: a hand-composed primitive whose self-owned visibility condition is unsatisfied renders as empty comment nodes AND DELETES ITS R1 CHILDREN. velt-comment-sidebar-close-button-v2 computes shouldShow = defaultCondition ? !embedMode : true, so in an embedded sidebar the built-in is hidden by design and takes hand-placed children with it.
learnings.evidence: child span vanished as <!----><!---->; adding defaultCondition={false} restored it and stopped the SDK warning. Same shape ('if (!this.defaultCondition()) return true;') in velt-comment-sidebar-list-v2 (needs filteredAnnotations.length>0 && !noCommentsFound) and velt-comment-sidebar-page-mode-composer-v2 (needs pageMode && pageCommentAnnotation && user).

learnings.statement: Velt's '<tag> does not support children ... or use a wireframe for this element' console warning is MISLEADING and points at the wrong layer: the tag DOES support R1 children, it simply had no mounted template to move them into because its visibility condition was unsatisfied. Taken at face value it pushes a `strictly primitives` build into a forbidden layer switch.
learnings.evidence: warning emitted while the condition was unsatisfied; after defaultCondition={false} the child replaced the SDK glyph and the warning stopped.

learnings.statement: VeltCommentSidebarV2Header / ...CloseButton (and siblings) DROP className and ref: their interfaces extend React.DetailedHTMLProps so className type-checks, but the implementations destructure only defaultCondition and children and forward no ...rest. A stylesheet keyed to a vcClass placed on these tags silently never matches.
learnings.evidence: classAttr null on both tags in live DOM after passing className; style stage must key off tag names instead.

learnings.statement: manifest/velt-primitives.json records parentOwnedConditions:null for velt-comment-sidebar-close-button-v2, which provably HAS a self-owned visibility condition — so lint-primitives' P6 net has a hole and stayed silent on a real dead-control risk.
learnings.evidence: lint exit 0 while the composed control's children were being deleted at runtime.

learnings.statement: React onClick is silently DEAD on R1 children inside a Velt dropdown. The dropdown container calls stopPropagation on 'click'; React 17+ delegates at the root container, so no synthetic event is produced at all even though the node still holds its __reactProps$…onClick. pointerdown/mousedown are NOT stopped — use onPointerDown.
learnings.evidence: instrumented every ancestor: click fires on span -> div.velt-sidebar-filter-trigger-container -> span.velt-sidebar-filter-dropdown-container -> dies; docClick:0 while docPointerDown:1. A synthetic .click() fails identically, so it is stopPropagation, not real-vs-synthetic.

learnings.statement: A hand-composed Velt dropdown has NO open/close behaviour at all — the behaviour lives in the template that R1 children replace, not on the trigger or content elements. The builder must own visibility (defaultCondition={false} + own {open && ...}). Left unowned the content renders PERMANENTLY EXPANDED.
learnings.evidence: filter content rendered 150x287 in a header whose design is a 97x32 closed select; a real pointer click on the MultiThread actions trigger left aria-expanded="false" (toggleMinimalActionsDropdown inert outside its host).

learnings.statement: lint-primitives P3 FALSE POSITIVE: an inline {open ? (<VeltFoo>...</VeltFoo>) : null} child of a primitive trips P3 because consumeText only strips BALANCED {...} runs, and the fragment between tags is the unbalanced '{filterOpen ? (' so it reads as plain text. Workaround: hoist the JSX to a const and interpolate one balanced {expr} — same React output, lint clean.

judge2-chromatic.mjs CRASHES with 'The value of "size" is out of range' / Buffer.alloc(negative) whenever the Figma frame export scale differs from the live capture scale. Figma State frames are 2x exports of a 552 CSS px surface (1104px wide) while the live rail captures at devicePixelRatio 1 and 354 CSS px; findBestTemplateMatch falls back to full-panel, visualDiff's canvas becomes 1104 wide, and a region box at x>354 reaches cropImage where w = img.width - x goes NEGATIVE.
learnings.evidence: Received -72312; zero per-block diff numbers produced for the whole phase; judge had to fall back to direct DOM-vs-designSpec measurement

learnings.statement: judge2-chrome-probes silently NO-OPS in `strictly primitives` mode: its selectors (.vc-body, .vc-card, .velt-comment-dialog--sidebar-mode) match 0 elements because Velt primitives drop className, so card-side-borders-invisible, card-double-border, thread-rail-on-single-comment, thread-rail-show-n-mismatch and inter-dialog-gap-mismatch all report nothing. The single emitted row 'chrome-probe-empty-sidebar' is a PROBE-SELECTOR MISS, not an empty sidebar — 3 real cards render as div.vc-comment-card.

velt-comment-dialog-thread-card and velt-comment-dialog-toggle-reply are listed as children-accepting containers in manifest/velt-codeconnect.json and pass lint P2, but REJECT CHILDREN at runtime on sdk@6.0.8-beta.1 ('does not support children ... This primitive renders its own child primitives instead'). Consequence beyond layout: the container never mounts, so the CLICK OWNER never exists — every composed card and reply-toggle renders pixel-correct and is completely DEAD. defaultCondition={false} does NOT help (different failure class from the visibility-condition case).
learnings.evidence: querySelectorAll('velt-comment-dialog-thread-card')=0; real pointer clicks at freshly-measured coords on card/head/message/avatar and on reply count/text all landed on target and produced ZERO delta (docEls 401->401, cards 3->3, innerText 237->237 chars, cdk-overlay 0x0 display:none document-wide, 0 console messages)

learnings.statement: The V2 sidebar close button is DEAD under embedMode when hand-composed: velt-comment-sidebar-close-button-v2's (click) reaches actionService.closeSidebar() -> commentService.setSidebarVisibility(false,false,true), but V2's closeSidebar() has no .emit() (unlike V1), so no sidebarClose event is delivered on commentElement.on('sidebarClose') and the host never learns to collapse its rail.
learnings.evidence: click at (1175,101) with elementFromPoint returning the button's own <path>; rail box unchanged [1158,63,354,837], .velt-sidebar-container.visible still present, docEls/railEls/innerText identical. Predicted from source by builder 1 and independently reproduced by the judge.

learnings.statement: '<VeltCommentsSidebar\b' can never match '<VeltCommentsSidebarV2' (no word boundary between 'r' and 'V'), so a V2 host mount was invisible to the gate and every sidebar hostProp reported MISSING forever — FIXED: HOST_TAG_FALLBACKS=[V2,V1,VeltComments] used in BOTH evaluateHostSource and the --apply target lookup
learnings.evidence: fixture test: V1 regex still returns null on V2 src (no regression); V2 tag resolves; V2-only host evaluates 0 missing. contract-check selftest exit 0.

learnings.statement: checkPropInSource with plan value:true accepted only {true} or a bare prop, so a prop the SDK TYPES as string (IVeltCommentSidebarV2Props.embedMode?: string, host must write embedMode="true") could never satisfy the gate — it demanded a spelling the host could not type-check its way into — FIXED: accept prop="true" and prop={"true"} as satisfying value:true; explicitly REJECT the "false" spellings in both forms
learnings.evidence: 9/9 fixture assertions pass incl. 4 regression guards; real gate went 6/8 -> 7/8 present with only the inferred pageModeComposerVariant row remaining

learnings.statement: Preflight item 6 (auth) can PASS on 'velt booted + tags present' while getUser() is null and NO data stream exists. Booted != authed != has-data. The auth preflight must assert a non-null getUser() AND a data-bearing subscription, or 5/11 blocks reach the style stage measuring an empty surface.
learnings.evidence: getUser() now returns {type:signedIn,userId:user1,organizationId:owner-org-1}; .vc-document-id='harvey-doc-7'; .vc-unread-count='0 unread' — both previously empty

learnings.statement: mock-gate is structurally inapplicable to `strictly primitives` runs — it requires mocks/ that only the wireframe-path structure builder produces. The primitives path needs an equivalent gate or an explicit mode skip, otherwise every primitives run hits a spurious exit 2 before build-style.
learnings.evidence: mock-gate compares live free-draw MOCKS against the frame PNGs. Free-draw mocks are a WIREFRAME-path artifact produced by velt-builder in mode=structure; velt-builder-primitives composes a primitive tree and never produces mocks/. The gate's precondition cannot exist in `strictly primitives`.

learnings.fact: filter/actions dropdown menus render INLINE inside the host rail, NOT in a document.body CDK overlay
learnings.was: plan globalNotes.hostConstraints[1] said CDK overlay -> global selectors
learnings.now: inOverlay:false, zero overlay containers -> RAIL-SCOPED selectors

learnings.fact: Velt primitives drop className and ref (no ...rest forwarding) so style must key off tag names
learnings.was: plan placed vcClasses on Velt primitive tags

learnings.fact: velt-comment-dialog-thread-card and -toggle-reply reject children at runtime despite being registry containers that pass lint P2
learnings.was: treated as containers by the plan
learnings.now: container never mounts so the CLICK OWNER never exists — composed cards render perfectly and are DEAD

learnings.fact: embedMode is typed string on IVeltCommentSidebarV2Props but boolean on V1

learnings.gap: V2 closeSidebar() has no .emit() so the collapse control is dead under embedMode
learnings.impact: host must own rail collapse state
